# libairspyhf

Source: https://github.com/airspy/airspyhf

Revision: eebf116c4a1dc52a6978a3a1f7968a5fa7f065f9

The sources are based on this upstream revision. A local accessor exposes whether
the upstream driver fell back to its default sample rate after a firmware query
failed; it does not change the driver selection or DSP behavior. See LICENSE.BSD
and the copyright notices in the source files.
